arguments.task_description: Add a cache-aside layer to the Taskboard FastAPI API using Redis 7 (redis-py): cache a user's team list and project list, task lists per project per page/filter/sort combination, task detail and user profile. Every write invalidates the affected keys after the database commit (versioned keys for task-list families), TTLs are a backstop. Values are JSON. The cache sits behind an interface with Redis, in-memory and no-op implementations; on Redis errors it degrades to cache misses. Hit/miss counters are exposed on an admin-only stats endpoint and logged at debug level. Authorization checks always run against PostgreSQL before cached data is returned.
